JWTAuthWeaknessMonitor.name: JWTAuthWeaknessMonitor
JWTAuthWeaknessMonitor.description: Detects JWT algorithm weaknesses (none alg), missing/expired claims, role confusion, BOLA/IDOR patterns, OAuth flaws, and API key leaks via token analysis or HAR traffic scanning.
JWTAuthWeaknessMonitor.input_contract: JWT token string or .har traffic file path
JWTAuthWeaknessMonitor.output_contract: Structured report with severity (Critical/High/Medium) and specific weakness flags
